name: Masaba
notes: Ancestor of the Bamasaba, and their name for Mount Elgon.

name: Nafuna
notes: A girl born feet or buttocks first. The male form is Sifuna.

name: Nekesa
notes: Male form is Wekesa. Shared with Bukusu.

name: Mukhwana
notes: The second twin is Mulongo. Shared with Bukusu.

name: Wepukhulu
notes: A survival name, given when earlier children had died. Shared with Bukusu.

name: Khakasa
notes: In Bukusu tradition, a girl noted for a fair complexion. Male form is Wakasa.

name: Mwambu
notes: Son of Masaba in Bamasaba tradition, nicknamed Mugisu.

name: Wafula
notes: Female form is Nafula. Shared with Bukusu.

name: Kuloba
notes: A survival name. Shared with Bukusu.

name: Wanale
notes: Son of Masaba in Bamasaba tradition.

name: Wanyama
meaning_en: born at a time of feasting

name: Wabwire
notes: Female form is Nabwire. Ugandan spelling of the Masaba name also written Wabwile.

name: Wakoli
notes: Also a clan-linked name among Bukusu.

name: Kitutu
notes: Also the name of a ridge and clan area in Bugisu.

name: Ishimwe
notes: From gushima, to thank or praise.

name: Habyarimana
meaning_en: it is God who gives children

name: Ntare
notes: Also a historical royal name in Burundi.

name: Mukasa
notes: Clan name and the spirit of Lake Victoria.

name: Wasswa
notes: Lusoga uses Waiswa for the same birth position.

name: Kato
notes: Lusoga uses Tenywa for the same birth position.

name: Namirembe
notes: Also the name of a hill in Kampala.

name: Kizito
notes: Given name of one of the Uganda Martyrs.

name: Nambi
notes: Wife of Kintu in the Buganda founding tradition.

name: Kintu
notes: Founding ancestor in the Buganda tradition.

name: Waiswa
notes: Luganda uses Wasswa for the same birth position.

name: Mukama
notes: Also a word for God or a ruler, used across the interlacustrine languages.

name: Tenywa
notes: Luganda uses Kato for the same birth position.

name: Ngobi
notes: Royal clan name of Busoga, also a personal name.

name: Menya
notes: Also the hereditary title Menha of Bugweri.

name: Tabingwa
notes: Hereditary title of Luuka, also a personal name.

name: Wambuzi
notes: Also associated with the Zibondo line of Bulamogi.

name: Dhikusoka
notes: The dh spelling is characteristic of Lusoga.

name: Gabula
notes: Hereditary title of Bugabula, also a personal name.

name: Nadiope
notes: Royal name of the Bugabula line.

name: Kadhumbula
notes: Royal name of the Bugabula line.

name: Muloki
notes: Royal name of the Zibondo line.

name: Wako
notes: Royal name of the Zibondo line.

name: Zibondo
notes: Hereditary title of Bulamogi, also a personal name.

name: Wakooli
notes: Hereditary title of Bukooli, also a personal name.

name: Kisiki
notes: Hereditary title of Busiki, also a personal name.

name: Nkono
notes: Hereditary title of Bukono, also a personal name.

name: Ntembe
notes: Hereditary title of Butembe, also a personal name.

name: Luba
notes: Hereditary title of Bunya, also a personal name.

name: Nanyumba
notes: Hereditary title of Bunhole, also spelled Nanhumba.

name: Nabwana
notes: Name of the Luuka royal line.

name: Nkuutu
notes: Name associated with the Menha of Bugweri.

name: Waguma
notes: Name associated with the Ntembe of Butembe.

name: Izimba
notes: Name associated with the Ngobi of Kigulu.

name: Gologolo
notes: Name associated with the Ngobi of Kigulu.

name: Natukunda
notes: As a surname, borne by any gender.

name: Nyakato
notes: Western form of the twin name Nakato.

name: Byarugaba
notes: Rugaba is a name of the Creator.

name: Aisha
notes: Arabic name long established in Swahili.

name: Amina
notes: Swahili form of the name of the Prophet's mother.

name: Bakari
notes: Swahili name linked with the name Abu Bakr.

name: Mwaka
notes: A child born in a year of plenty.

name: Ali
notes: Arabic name long established in Swahili.

name: Mwinyi
notes: Coastal Swahili name and title of respect, also used as a personal name.
